requirement: The system shall four separately deployable products share versioned common contracts: Scorekeeper, Arena, League, Tournament Director.
The system shall apache-2.0 license for original code; trademarks/art and third-party components identified separately.
The system shall build and test core libraries and server using CLI .NET SDK without Visual Studio, Azure or commercial control packages.
The system shall run core libraries and hosted server on Windows and Linux; platform-specific adapters are isolated.
The system shall export and restore organization data in documented JSON/CSV with schema versions and integrity checks.
The system shall publish software bill of materials and conduct CI dependency license/security scans.
The system shall provide self-host documentation and provider-neutral backups, deployments and migrations.
The system shall expose documented extension points for scheduler and scoreboard adapters.
The system shall windows touchscreen and keyboard/mouse workflows function without network.
The system shall clock, period, scores, penalty clocks, local/cloud/hardware status visible in one glance.
The system shall primary touch controls at least 48 x 48 effective pixels at supported scaling; test with gloves where practical.
The system shall support 125–200% scaling, keyboard equivalents, color-independent signaling and accessibility labels.
The system shall no modal dialog obscures running clock; disruptive corrections require explicit confirmation.
The system shall record goal or penalty with minimal steps; support undo as audited correction.
The system shall after action, show whether local durable commit succeeded; cloud receipt displayed separately.
The system shall restore focus and state after display disconnect, UI restart, or resolution change.
The system shall support light/dark rink themes, team colors, touch calibration and operator customization.
The system shall run timed usability drills with novice volunteers and tournament timekeepers.
The system shall exactly one local authoritative game-clock owner and epoch at a time.
The system shall compute game time from monotonic elapsed duration, not periodic decrement callbacks.
The system shall clock start, stop, set, period transition and authority change are durable audited events.
The system shall on unknown downtime, suspend clock and require explicit recovery decision; do not silently advance.
The system shall process official mutations through one serialized command channel with invariant validation.
The system shall commit official event and related local outbox record in one SQLite transaction before confirmation.
The system shall uI and asynchronous adapter work cannot block the authoritative command queue indefinitely.
The system shall support configurable stop-time, running time, overtime, intermission and mercy rules via versioned profiles.
The system shall simulate clock and failures using TimeProvider/injected monotonic-clock abstraction.
The system shall support keyboard and optional external clock switch with debounce and fail-safe state.
The system shall record goals, scorer, up to configured assists, strength, time and participating roster entry.
The system shall implement minors, double-minors, majors, misconducts, match penalties and coincidentals as profile-supported.
The system shall derive manpower, penalty timing, eligibility and goal termination deterministically from casebook-verified rule profiles.
The system shall record delayed penalty, penalty queue, release and coincidental offset with explicit operator explanations.
The system shall never hard-code one sanction body: bind every game to a rule profile, edition and effective date.
The system shall preserve audited goal, penalty, scorer and time corrections as compensating events.
The system shall generate official scoresheet PDF and structured export with sign/certify workflow.
The system shall require referee/league procedural acceptance before claiming an official electronic game sheet.
The system shall track shots, saves, goalie changes and optional faceoffs with configurable statistics rules.
The system shall expose operator-assisted discrepancy review rather than auto-fixing score or penalty state.
The system shall separate season, tournament and per-game rosters with independent version histories.
The system shall enable offline local creation/editing of a team, player, number, position and roster status.
The system shall allow temporary tournament guest or substitute with eligibility state and reason.
The system shall freeze game roster identity snapshot when game starts; subsequent edits do not rewrite prior events.
The system shall flag duplicate jersey numbers and ambiguous player identity; allow documented override.
The system shall use stable non-public person identifiers so jersey changes do not fragment player statistics.
The system shall merge downloaded roster versions only with explicit field/record conflict policy and review.
The system shall permit scratch, starting goalie and late arrival annotations with role attribution.
The system shall support CSV import with preview, validation, rollback and duplicate matching.
The system shall provide tournament check-in and approval status per team and division.
The system shall persist each command outcome and immutable event locally before any network-dependent work.
The system shall synchronize via durable transactional outbox with bounded retry and exponential backoff.
The system shall server deduplicates submissions by event ID, origin and sequence; identical repeats have identical result.
The system shall display distinct statuses: locally saved, queued, uploading, acknowledged, conflict, rejected.
The system shall upload causally ordered event streams and fetch versioned assignments, schedules, rosters and profiles.
The system shall reject conflicting authoritative game streams into explicit reconciliation queue; never last-write-wins.
The system shall resumable sync survives power loss mid-batch, server restart and token expiry.
The system shall preserve games locally indefinitely until safe archival; never purge on mere upload attempt.
The system shall bind game assignment, device lease and server authority claim to limit split-brain scoring.
The system shall provide manual retry, export, diagnostics, last acknowledgment and sync health indicators.
The system shall support streamed live updates with eventual correctness after reconnection.
The system shall reconcile time corrections and schedule version updates without altering in-progress game authority.
The system shall expose ASP.NET Core API and responsive administrative/public experiences from one deployable modular monolith.
The system shall support tenant organization, league, division, season, team, game and roster CRUD with audit trail.
The system shall support authentication, scoped roles, least-privilege authorization and audit logs for privileged writes.
The system shall publish live scores, certified final scores, league schedules, standings and brackets distinctly.
The system shall calculate standings and player statistics from certified versioned records and traceable policies.
The system shall prevent publication of child personal data beyond approved visibility policy and roles.
The system shall enable game assignment/download by a recognized scoring terminal and revoke devices.
The system shall provide league admin screens for corrections, contested results, roster approval and sync conflicts.
The system shall support searchable leaderboards, goalie stats, export, sponsor-safe branding and responsive team pages.
The system shall support SignalR push with polling fallback and server-rendered basic pages.
The system shall support hosted tournaments with multiple facilities, arenas, ice sheets and time-zone-aware availability.
The system shall represent each assignment by stable game ID, venue, sheet, start/end, buffer and schedule revision.
The system shall support divisions, seeded pools, round robin, crossovers, placement games and single-elimination brackets.
The system shall configure per-division game lengths, ice cuts, check-in, minimum rest, max daily games and travel matrix.
The system shall never permit team, sheet or assigned official overlaps in a published schedule.
The system shall use Google OR-Tools CP-SAT via versioned solver adapter; run solver locally or on hosted worker.
The system shall clearly label mandatory constraints versus weighted preferences and provide explanation for infeasibility.
The system shall support pinned games, manual moves with continuous conflict checks, and limited-scope rescheduling.
The system shall model uncertain qualifiers as placeholders until requisite pool games are certified.
The system shall version standings and tiebreaker rules; support head-to-head, differential caps and fair-play policies as configured.
The system shall publish schedule revisions atomically; scorekeepers acknowledge or surface stale version warnings.
The system shall never automatically move game marked checked-in, active or finalized without authorized workflow.
The system shall support delayed games, no-shows, forfeits, venue closures and cascading impact analysis.
The system shall give director a live multi-venue grid, conflicts, progress, games-at-risk and notifications.
The system shall support referee assignment, breaks, qualifications and conflicts as optional resources.
The system shall support organizer-branded hosted event web page, QR check-in and controlled exports.
The system shall enable organizer billing/hosting without charging scorekeepers to operate offline.
The system shall provide scheduler reproducibility metadata: model version, seed, solve settings, constraint set.
The system shall separate clock authority from read-only scoreboard observations and visual display outputs.
The system shall provide HDMI/video scoreboard output with legible clock, scores, period and penalties at distance.
The system shall hardware adapters declare verified capabilities and actual transport; unsupported control must be unavailable.
The system shall adapter disconnect, stale packets or display freeze cannot corrupt official local game state.
The system shall provide optional Windows/mini-PC arena gateway exposing authenticated LAN interfaces.
The system shall provide camera-assisted scoreboard OCR with confidence, staleness, calibration and manual fallback.
The system shall support physical start-stop control with safe debounce, device identification and log of transitions.
The system shall provide simulated Daktronics/OES/Nevco adapters pending lawful access and hardware verification.
The system shall use TLS and modern authenticated authorization for all server mutations; no anonymous admin endpoints.
The system shall store only necessary youth/player information; configurable private/public profiles and retention rules.
The system shall encrypt secrets in appropriate OS secret store; never commit credentials or API keys.
The system shall use database migrations, verified restore drills, off-host backups and documented RPO/RTO targets.
The system shall rate-limit external APIs, guard tenant isolation and validate all incoming files and payloads.
The system shall emit structured logs, health metrics, trace IDs and privacy-conscious diagnostic export.
The system shall support small Linux VPS deployment with reverse proxy, Postgres and repeatable config.
The system shall maintain signed release artifacts, SBOM, vulnerability triage and rollback strategy.
The system shall provide regional hosting/data retention configuration and documented incident response procedures.
The system shall support tenant archival and export prior to deletion.
The system shall unit, integration, casebook fixture, replay, property-based, concurrency and crash-injection suites run automatically.
The system shall clock tests use fake time; avoid sleeps in correctness-critical cases.
The system shall use fault harness to simulate network partitions, disk-full, repeated submits, UI crashes and adapter failure.
The system shall all P0 requirements map to automated test or named manual acceptance procedure.
The system shall linux and Windows CLI builds must pass CI from clean checkout with no proprietary IDE.
The system shall test tournament solver for validity, infeasible input explanation and schedule stability after a localized change.
The system shall run touchscreen usability review with referee, scorer/timekeeper, coach and organizer before pilot release.
The system shall block release on known P0 game-rule or data-loss defects, critical vulnerabilities or failed restore drill.
The system shall run real hardware-in-loop test per vendor adapter before enabling write operations.
The system shall run performance and accessibility regression tests on published reference devices.

requirement: On each committed authoritative game event, write a deterministic human-readable text mirror with event ID, game ID, event sequence, UTC wall time, period, game clock, operator ID, event type and before/after values.
verification: Unit+integration: 100-event game log matches ordered journal projection.

section: v4 source audit and game logging addendum
requirement: Text mirror is append-only; never overwrite or delete original event entries when corrected.
verification: Unit: correction appends referencing original event ID; original bytes unchanged.

section: v4 source audit and game logging addendum
requirement: SQLite event journal and outbox commit atomically before acknowledging a scoring action; text mirror is a secondary recoverable projection.
verification: Crash injection between commit, mirror write and ACK; exactly-once journal effect.

section: v4 source audit and game logging addendum
requirement: If text mirror write fails, surface a persistent degraded-logging alert and enqueue retry; do not silently claim dual logging succeeded.
verification: Inject disk-full and permissions error; alert + rebuild from journal.

section: v4 source audit and game logging addendum
requirement: Allow full or selected game log export to .txt and .jsonl with integrity metadata and no unnecessary personal information.

section: v4 source audit and game logging addendum

verification: Kill after journal commit before text append; restart and reconcile.
